name: Territory of the Military Commander in Serbia
wikipedia: Territory of the Military Commander in Serbia

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)
predecessors.text: the Serbian core of the Kingdom of Yugoslavia, which 'Germany occupied ... outright and placed ... under direct military administration' after the surrender of 17 April 1941

successors.name: Yugoslav Partisans
successors.text: 'Most of Serbia was liberated from the Germans over the course of the Belgrade Offensive'; Red Army 'took the city on 20 October' 1944

rulers.name: Milan Nedić
rulers.title: Head of the Government of National Salvation (Serbian puppet government under the German Military Commander)

ledger.x: 22 April 1941: German Military Commander takes charge of occupied Serbia.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: 28 July 1941: the Partisans enter Užice and found the Republic of Užice.
29 August 1941: Serbia gets a puppet government.
1 December 1941: the Germans reconquer the Republic of Užice.
October 1944: the Red Army and the Partisans take Serbia.
20 October 1944: the Territory of the Military Commander in Serbia ends.

wars.name: Invasion of Yugoslavia
wars.outcome: Germany, Italy and Hungary invaded Yugoslavia on 6 April 1941; the unconditional surrender was signed on 17 April 1941 and Germany occupied Serbia outright under direct military administration on 22 April.

wars.name: First anti-Partisan offensive
wars.outcome: German troops reconquer the Republic of Užice (conquered 1 December 1941); the Partisans withdraw to Bosnia, Sandžak and Montenegro.

wars.name: Belgrade offensive
wars.outcome: The Red Army and the Partisans take Belgrade on 20 October 1944; the German administration is evacuated to Vienna and the Territory ends.

certainty.note: The pages name the Territory's parts (central Serbia, the Banat, north Kosovo) but not its borders with the Bulgarian, Hungarian and Croatian zones, which moved (eastern Syrmia was 'initially included'); the border with Montenegro is not…
